releaseNotes: Supercar Instrument Cluster & Upgraded Previews: 1) Realistic 2026 supercar digital cockpit with calibrated 250° radial GPS velocity gauge (0-160 MPH / 240 KM/H). 2) Fine measurement ticks, major numbering, hairlines, and subtle redline sector (85%-100%). 3) Large pure-white digital speed numerals with smooth 70ms laser sweep needle responding to real GPS velocity. 4) Flanking wings for Trip, Peak speed, GPS precision, BLE link, battery voltage, and coolant temp. 5) Strict sensor integrity: displays calibrated GPS speed and standby indicator when RPM is offline. 6) Elevated settings preview card with high-fidelity realistic renderings.
